title: Outbuilding area, ridge height and location per Table 2.6a
text: C2.6.1 Any outbuilding is provided in accordance with Table 2.6a, provided that it: i. is set back or built up to lot boundaries in accordance with C3.4.1, C3.4.4, C3.4.5 or C3.4.6; ii. does not exceed the maximum allowable site cover in accordance with C3.1.1; iii. does not reduce the minimum outdoor living area or primary garden area required in accordance with C1.1.1 or C1.1.3; iv. does not reduce the minimum soft landscaping required in accordance with C1.2.1; and v. does not reduce the minimum tree provision and associated deep soil area in accordance with C1.2.4. Table 2.6a Outbuilding provisions: maximum individual or collective area per site 60m2; maximum wall height 3m; maximum ridge height 4.2m; location: not located within the primary or secondary street setback area. Refer to Figure 2.6a for wall and ridge height guidance.

replaces.note: R25 and below: '60m2 or 10% of site, whichever is lesser' -> 60m2; small-shed category removed

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Table 2.6a p22: maximum individual or collective area 60m2 per site; ridge 4.2 m; not in the primary or secondary street setback area. Wall height is C2.6.1-r1. Cross-references (i)-(v) are tested by their own rules; Chapter 3 lists C3.4.1, C3.4.4, C3.4.5 or C3.4.6 and the tree clause C1.2.4 (Chapter 2: C3.4.1, C3.4.5, C3.4.6 and C1.2.3). Register ch3-035: 'per site' for a grouped dwelling reads as the dwelling site, so each may carry up to 60m2. Must also meet the NCC.
